info.title: Standard Dashboard Configuration
info.description: Schema for Chronosphere's standard dashboard configuration

auto.description: Whether to include the the auto option

auto_min_interval.description: The minimum interval to use when auto is enabled

auto_interval_size.description: The interval size to use when auto is enabled (Small, Medium, Large)

color.description: Valid colors are hex, rgb, rgba, hsl, hsla

line_style.description: Valid styles are Solid and Dashed

style.description: Valid styles are Solid and Dashed

limit.description: Maximum number of bars to display in the chart, defaults to 10,000 when not specified.

min.description: value associated with the lower end of the color scale (defaults to 0)

max.description: value associated with the upper end of the color scale (defaults to max value in the data set)

hideZeros.description: if true, leave 0-value / missing-value / negative-value cells empty

scale.description: Y-axis scale; leave unset for Auto selection from bucket encoding and value domain

mode.description: Interpret bounds as raw Y-axis values

min.description: Y-axis lower bound in raw axis units

max.description: Y-axis upper bound in raw axis units

mode.description: Interpret bounds as percentile ranks over histogram sample counts

bounds.description: Optional Y-axis trim; omit to use the complete data-derived extent

colorPalette.description: The kind of color palette to use. Categorical means we use just cycle through the color based on the series index. Consistent means we assign color by the series name and attempt to assign the same color across panels.

color.description: Valid colors are hex, rgb, rgba, hsl, hsla

line_style.description: Valid styles are Solid and Dashed

style.description: Valid styles are Solid and Dashed

start.description: Window start: a relative time (e.g. "now-7d", or "now/w" for the start of this week) or an ISO timestamp

end.description: Window end: a relative time (e.g. "now", or "now/w" for the end of this week) or an ISO timestamp
